title: UAAP: FEU men close first round with crucial win vs. Ateneo
summary: Far Eastern University closed the first round of the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament with a crucial 2-1 win over Ateneo de Manila University, Sunday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
